_comment: Placeholders to resolve before writing to <target-repo>/.claude/settings.json: fill BUILD_ALLOW_PATTERNS with this project's real build/test/lint commands (see references/stack-commands.md), fill VCS_ALLOW with the VCS read/write commands actually wanted (omit push unless the user wants agents pushing), and list this repo's actual local-secret env filenames explicitly under deny — do NOT deny a wildcard like './.env.*', since that also blocks reading '.env.example' (the committed, placeholder-only template file agents legitimately need to read/update; only the real .env variants are secret).
